projects.title: Mathtutor: AI tutoring vs. paper practice
projects.where: CATS Lab, Carnegie Mellon University (HCI REU)
projects.summary: A crossover study comparing students' learning gains when they practice math in Mathtutor, an AI-based tutoring system, versus on paper, with a focus on whether the tutor helps students with lower prior knowledge catch up or leaves them further behind.
contributions: Led confirmatory and exploratory analyses of learning gains, goal setting, and equity (the Matthew effect)
Built mixed-effects models in R with random effects for student, unit, class, and school
Assisted with strategy and learning-curve (iAFM) analyses
Led paper framing and writing; first author on a LAK 2027 submission (under review)
Created and presented a research poster

projects.title: Language acquisition research
projects.summary: Research assistant work on how people acquire language, which first got me interested in how a learner's background shapes learning.
contributions: Supported language acquisition studies as a research assistant
